title: Slow-Motion Action · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Slow-Motion Action · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose familiar activities, like making a sandwich, as prompts. The lead performs one action silently in exaggerated slow motion. The group guesses the action. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Slow-Motion Action, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
